title: Receipt
description: The normalized, dual-signed record of one purchase. Identical shape whether payment executed on a card rail or on-chain. Verifiable offline via `molt verify receipt.json` from this document and public keys alone.

tab_id.description: The tab under which this purchase executed.

mandate_id.description: The child mandate this purchase consumed.

rung.description: Ladder rung that executed: L0 native protocol, L1 platform adapter, L2 browser automation, L3 human deep link. Provenance is declared, never hidden.

rail.description: Payment rail. v1 rails are test-money only.

merchant.description: Merchant origin the purchase executed at.

amount_minor.description: Settled amount in integer minor units.

evidence.description: Hashes of evidence captured at the commit moment. Artifacts are stored separately, addressed by hash.

dom_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the checkout-confirmation DOM snapshot.

onchain_tx_hash.description: L0 only: transaction hash on Base Sepolia.

idempotency_key.description: Derived from (tab, merchant, cart hash). A key may commit at most once; re-invocation with the same cart never double-orders.

mandate_chain.description: Mandate ID chain from root to the consumed child, root first.

agent_signature.description: Signature by the agent key over the canonical receipt body (all fields except the two signatures).

ta_signature.description: Countersignature by the Tab Authority key over the canonical receipt body plus agent_signature.
